name: AI Policy & Strategic Governance
audit_question: Does the organization have an approved, documented AI policy defining strategic objectives, risk boundaries, and executive oversight?
remediation_guidance: Draft and ratify a formal AI Governance Charter establishing executive accountability, permitted AI use-cases, and quarterly compliance reviews.

name: AI Roles & Responsibility Matrix
audit_question: Are specific operational and legal responsibilities clearly assigned for AI system procurement, development, and deployment?
remediation_guidance: Publish a RACI matrix designating an AI Ethics & Compliance Officer and technical system owners across all B2B workflows.

name: AI Asset Inventory & Record of Processing
audit_question: Is there a centralized, up-to-date registry of all active AI models, vendor APIs, and autonomous agent instances in the organization?
remediation_guidance: Implement an automated AI Asset Register detailing model architectures, data sources, hosting environments, and business purposes.

name: AI System Classification & Tier Assessment
audit_question: Are all AI systems classified into EU AI Act risk tiers (Prohibited, High-Risk, Specific Transparency, or Minimal Risk)?
remediation_guidance: Conduct a mandatory Tier Assessment checklist before deploying any AI tool to identify High-Risk Annex III triggers.

name: Mandatory AI Literacy & Workforce Training
audit_question: Are staff members operating or overseeing AI systems trained in AI capabilities, prompt engineering boundaries, and regulatory obligations?
remediation_guidance: Deliver annual AI Literacy certification covering EU AI Act requirements, hallucination mitigation, and sensitive data protection.

name: AI Whistleblowing & Feedback Channels
audit_question: Is there an anonymous, protected mechanism for employees and contractors to report AI ethics breaches or safety concerns?
remediation_guidance: Integrate AI grievance and safety reporting into the corporate whistleblower portal with guaranteed non-retaliation protections.

name: Continuous AI Risk Management System
audit_question: Is an iterative risk management process maintained across the entire AI lifecycle, identifying risks to health, safety, and fundamental rights?
remediation_guidance: Deploy a continuous risk assessment matrix tracking pre-deployment testing, operational drifts, and recurring mitigations.

name: Prohibited AI Practices Screening
audit_question: Is there verification that no AI systems utilize subliminal techniques, social scoring, emotion recognition in workplaces, or untargeted facial scraping?
remediation_guidance: Enforce strict pre-procurement checklists rejecting any vendor software that touches Article 5 prohibited categories.

name: Residual Risk Thresholds & CFO Acceptance
audit_question: Are residual risks judged acceptable against documented thresholds and approved by corporate management before live release?
remediation_guidance: Establish quantitative risk tolerance metrics and require formal sign-off from Legal and Executive Management on residual exposures.

name: Post-Market Monitoring Plan
audit_question: Is there a documented post-market monitoring plan that systematically analyzes operational data throughout the AI system lifetime?
remediation_guidance: Institute scheduled post-market performance reviews and feedback telemetry collection conforming to Article 72 standards.

name: Serious Incident Reporting Protocol
audit_question: Are procedures established to report any serious incident or malfunction to relevant national market surveillance authorities within 15 days?
remediation_guidance: Formalize an AI Incident Response Playbook with predetermined templates and regulatory notification contacts.

name: Training & Validation Data Governance
audit_question: Are training, validation, and testing datasets subjected to data governance practices addressing design choices and collection origin?
remediation_guidance: Implement data curation pipelines that document sampling methodologies, cleaning transformations, and statistical validity checks.

name: Bias Mitigation & Demographic Fairness
audit_question: Are datasets audited for statistical biases that may lead to discriminatory outputs against protected characteristics or customer classes?
remediation_guidance: Run automated disparity and parity testing across demographic attributes prior to model fine-tuning and deployment.

name: Data Lineage & Provenance Tracking
audit_question: Can every data point ingested into AI pipelines be traced back to its licensed source, timestamp, and legal basis?
remediation_guidance: Maintain immutable data manifests and cryptographic hashes of training datasets to ensure intellectual property and copyright defensibility.

name: PII Minimization & Zero Cloud Transmission
audit_question: Does the system prevent personal identification data (PII) from being leaked, sent to unvetted cloud APIs, or used for model re-training?
remediation_guidance: Deploy local-first architecture (such as ZUKWEND Core AI) ensuring corporate financial and invoice data never leaves host hardware.

name: Dataset Completeness & Quality Metrics
audit_question: Are datasets evaluated against formal quality metrics such as representativeness, completeness, and absence of errors?
remediation_guidance: Establish automated unit tests for dataset completeness and outlier detection before pipeline ingestion.

name: Special Category Data Safeguards
audit_question: When processing special categories of data under GDPR for bias detection, are strict synthetic masking and state-of-the-art security applied?
remediation_guidance: Enforce automated pseudonymization and differential privacy safeguards whenever sensitive data attributes must be inspected.

name: Annex IV Technical Documentation File
audit_question: Is comprehensive technical documentation compiled prior to market release, fulfilling Annex IV requirements for architecture and design?
remediation_guidance: Compile an Annex IV Master File including system architecture diagrams, algorithm descriptions, dependencies, and design choices.

name: Automated Event Logging & Audit Trail
audit_question: Does the AI system automatically generate unalterable logs recording operational periods, inputs, reference databases, and system outputs?
remediation_guidance: Implement tamper-proof local event logging capturing all execution timestamps, prompt parameters, and operator interventions for at least 6 months.

name: Model Cards & System Specification Sheets
audit_question: Are standardized model cards published internally for each model, summarizing intended use, performance benchmarks, and known limitations?
remediation_guidance: Standardize Model Cards across all internal AI pipelines utilizing the Hugging Face / ISO 42001 metadata standard.

name: Validation & Verification Test Logs
audit_question: Are test results and verification logs archived and traceable across each software build and model version increment?
remediation_guidance: Integrate automated CI/CD compliance gates storing unit test outputs, regression benchmarks, and validation sign-offs.

name: Software Bill of Materials (SBOM) for AI
audit_question: Is an accurate Software Bill of Materials (SBOM) maintained for all open-source libraries, Python packages, and pre-trained weights?
remediation_guidance: Generate CycloneDX / SPDX SBOM manifests in every release package and run automated vulnerability checks against CVE databases.

name: EU Declaration of Conformity Readiness
audit_question: Is an EU Declaration of Conformity drafted, kept up-to-date, and ready to be retained for 10 years following market placement?
remediation_guidance: Prepare an Annex V EU Declaration template signed by legal representatives affirming conformity with harmonized standards.

name: User Instructions & Operational Transparency
audit_question: Are AI systems accompanied by clear, accessible instructions for use stating capabilities, limitations, and operational specifications?
remediation_guidance: Provide comprehensive User Manuals and UI warning labels explaining expected accuracy thresholds and operator verification requirements.

name: Direct AI Interaction Notification
audit_question: Are end-users explicitly informed in a timely and clear manner that they are interacting with an artificial intelligence system?
remediation_guidance: Implement conspicuous UI headers, banners, or intro messages stating 'AI-Powered System' before any human interaction occurs.

name: Synthetic Content Watermarking
audit_question: Are AI-generated text, documents, audio, or media outputs marked in a machine-readable format as artificially generated or manipulated?
remediation_guidance: Inject cryptographic watermarks or standard C2PA metadata into generated PDF reports and automated reminders.

name: Human-in-the-Loop Operational Safeguards
audit_question: Can human operators understand system recommendations, remain aware of automation bias, and override AI decisions before execution?
remediation_guidance: Enforce mandatory human confirmation gates for sensitive actions (such as dispatching formal payment demands or blocking customer accounts).

name: Emergency Stop & Autonomous Override Switch
audit_question: Does the interface provide a visible, instant mechanism allowing operators to halt autonomous AI execution or revert to a safe state?
remediation_guidance: Implement a deterministic kill-switch in desktop UI and server worker threads enabling immediate graceful cessation of automated tasks.

name: Explainability of Algorithmic Outputs
audit_question: Are algorithmic assessments accompanied by interpretable factors, confidence scores, and plain-language justifications?
remediation_guidance: Display weighted contributing factors alongside all risk scores, credit evaluations, and debt categorization outputs.

name: Right to Explanation for Impacted Persons
audit_question: Can affected business partners or individuals obtain clear and meaningful explanations of decisions made on the basis of AI outputs?
remediation_guidance: Provide an on-demand audit summary export feature explaining the data factors and logic leading to specific account classifications.

name: Continuous Accuracy Metrics & Benchmarking
audit_question: Are system accuracy, precision, and recall metrics formally benchmarked and monitored against domain-specific test suites?
remediation_guidance: Run automated regression test suites measuring extraction precision, F1-scores, and calculation accuracy on every release build.

name: Adversarial Robustness & Attack Simulation
audit_question: Is the AI system resilient against adversarial inputs intended to induce biased outputs, hallucinations, or system crashes?
remediation_guidance: Execute simulated red-team attacks with malformed PDFs, corrupted character encodings, and boundary-value stresses.

name: Prompt Injection & Jailbreak Defenses
audit_question: Are input sanitization and prompt defense layers active to block direct and indirect prompt injection attacks from untrusted document data?
remediation_guidance: Sanitize all user-supplied document strings using strict regex delimiters and hardened system instruction wrappers.

name: Data Poisoning & Weight Tampering Protection
audit_question: Are local model weights, cache files, and embeddings cryptographically protected against unauthorized alteration or poisoning?
remediation_guidance: Store model files in access-controlled directories and verify SHA-256 integrity hashes on application boot.

name: Graceful Degradation & Fail-Safe Fallback
audit_question: Does the AI system gracefully fall back to deterministic or manual procedures without data loss if models fail or disconnect?
remediation_guidance: Implement deterministic rule-based engines that guarantee basic operational continuity even when LLM endpoints are unavailable.

name: Third-Party AI Supplier Security Due Diligence
audit_question: Are cloud AI model providers (Anthropic, OpenAI, Google) vetted for enterprise data privacy, SLA guarantees, and zero-training commitments?
remediation_guidance: Mandate Bring-Your-Own-Key (BYOC) agreements with explicit enterprise zero-data-retention and zero-training commitments.

name: Air-Gapped & Local Isolation Capabilities
audit_question: Can critical AI workflows operate in completely air-gapped environments without any outbound Internet connectivity?
remediation_guidance: Architect core workflows to run 100% on localhost using native compiled agents or on-premise Ollama instances.

name: Cryptographic Signing & Authenticode EV Verification
audit_question: Are executable AI software binaries and model artifacts digitally signed with an Extended Validation (EV) certificate to prevent tampering?
remediation_guidance: Sign all Windows and macOS executables using Certum EV Code Signing certificates establishing high SmartScreen reputation.
